edges_rejected_or_unproved: Same nominal 72-juan title or 1608 date is not evidence that Wuxi and NCL 孫瑋 catalog items are the same printed plate or direct textual lineage.
Yangzhou '有补配' secondary catalogue qualifier blocks assigning an uninspected juan45 leaf uniformly to the original Xu-An 1599 state.
unresolved_lineage_questions: Obtain Wuxi exact census catalogue line linking provincial item02911 to shelfmark, real surviving juan, and juan45 original scan if publicly open.
Authenticate Yangzhou 02273 entry against the actual provincial appendix or first-party library record and determine which juan/leaves are replaced.
Collate a juan45 original from either only after copy and printed-plate identities are known; distinguish Wuxi's Zhang/Wang attribution from NCL Sun Wei attribution with colophon/printed target.

next_action: Keep Zhejiang 善002648, authenticated original NCL06270/SYSU, National Museum and 13VM/13VN as first priority. Wuxi02911 is a secondary independent institutional candidate at catalogue level only; use the Wuxi 2020 census exact entry and lawful publicly available scan if exposed. Yangzhou02273 requires original appendix or library-item verification and replacement-leaf inventory before any target textual vote. Do not request login, paid copying or user action by default.
